questions.stem: In paediatric infectious diseases, besides the child, whom does good management protect?
For a child with an infectious illness, what two decisions are needed about surgery?
questions.answer: Whether to delay surgery if possible, and how to manage the child if it cannot be delayed

questions.stem: In paediatric infectious diseases, how is the incubation period defined?
options: Time during which the patient can infect others
Time from symptom onset to diagnosis
Time from contact with an infected person to onset of disease
Time from vaccination to full immunity

questions.stem: In paediatric infectious diseases, what is the infectious period?
questions.answer: Time during which the patient can infect others

questions.stem: In paediatric infectious diseases, how can anaesthetic agents affect the child's immune response?
questions.answer: They may blunt the immune response, possibly raising the risk of severe complications
